title: A Comprehensive Report on the Mythologies of the Americas

cultures.name: Navajo (Diné)
cultures.creation: Emergence through several lower worlds into the present 'Glittering World'.
cultures.figures: Changing Woman (rejuvenation) and the Hero Twins (monster slayers).

cultures.name: Inuit
cultures.deity: Sedna, goddess of the sea, whose severed fingers became sea mammals.

cultures.name: Maya
cultures.text: The Popol Vuh details the creation of humans from maize.
cultures.narrative: The Hero Twins (Hunahpu and Xbalanque) defeating the lords of the underworld, Xibalba.

cultures.name: Aztec
cultures.cosmology: The Legend of the Five Suns and the necessity of sacrifice to sustain the current sun, Tonatiuh.

cultures.name: Inca
cultures.deities: Viracocha (Creator) and Inti (Sun God, ancestor of the Sapa Inca).
cultures.concept: Three realms: Hanan Pacha (Above), Kay Pacha (Earth), and Uku Pacha (Underworld).
